title: Farmers’ gathering outside Ministry of Agriculture over agricultural support demands
location: Tirana, outside Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development
organizer: United Farmers Union (Sindikata e Fermerëve të Bashkuar), as identified by Shqiptarja.com; Agim Rrapaj is named as head of the Council of Farmers, not necessarily the event organizer.
participants_original: No attendance number is reported in the opened Shqiptarja.com article; it states that the United Farmers Union protested outside the ministry.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown. The opened article confirms a protest but gives no crowd size or other evidence establishing at least 50 people.

title.summary: Shqiptarja.com and Balkanweb bodies confirm a United Farmers Union protest outside the Agriculture Ministry in Tirana. The exact Balkanweb URL is also duplicated in the March dossier and counts as one article; overlapping demand lists do not establish independent origin.

start_date.summary: Both opened reports date the protest to 8 February 2024.

location.summary: Both reports place the action outside the Agriculture Ministry in Tirana.

organizer.summary: The Shqiptarja.com body identifies the United Farmers Union as protesting. Balkanweb body does not name the organizer.

demands.summary: Both bodies list the same six agricultural requests (VAT parity, milk reimbursement, tax-free farm fuel, invoices at actual price, seed/seedling subsidies, and organic-product subsidies). Similarity may reflect shared origin; the Balkanweb result is also a duplicate URL across February and March units.

participants_original.summary: Neither opened body states an attendance count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither opened body provides count or other evidence that at least 50 people attended; threshold remains unknown.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; the opened report does not describe violence. Absence in this source does not establish nonviolence.

state_response.summary: Unknown; the opened report does not describe police or other state response.

episode_boundary.summary: Both articles announce later actions, with Shqiptarja saying Korçë on Saturday and Balkanweb saying Monday; Balkanweb predicts a Tirana culmination in early March. These conflicting plans do not prove later actions occurred or define an episode boundary.

notes: Two opened local-news pages (one exact Balkanweb URL) confirm the 8 February Tirana protest and overlapping six agricultural requests, but neither reports attendance, violence or state response. The Shqiptarja article names the United Farmers Union; Balkanweb does not identify an organizer. Both forecast later actions but disagree whether the Korçë start would be Saturday or Monday; plans are not execution evidence. Shared phrasing/list does not establish independent origin; attendance threshold remains unknown.
open_questions: Establish whether >=50 people physically attended; neither opened article gives a count.
Check the different announced Korçë start dates and verify whether later actions actually occurred; do not infer execution from plans.
Resolve whether the two similar six-item reports share an origin; Balkanweb has no byline in the read scope.
Seek separate evidence for police/state response and protester violence; neither opened report discusses these.
Establish campaign relation/end and episode boundary.

title: Devoll farmers’ protest outside local agriculture directorate over reduced milk prices
location: Devoll, outside agricultural directorate; precise site unknown
organizer: Devoll farmers and livestock breeders; formal organizer unknown
participants_original: No attendance count is reported in the opened Balkanweb S012 or Albania Daily News S013 articles; S012 mentions tractors but gives no number of people.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown. The two opened February 10 articles confirm reported gatherings and S012 mentions tractors, but neither establishes at least 50 people.

title.summary: Opened S012 and S013 both report a Feb 10 protest by Devoll farmers before the agriculture directorate (Bilisht named by S013); S012 also says livestock breeders joined. The distinct URLs and matching date/location suggest a relation, but the different grievance emphasis and no resolved reporting origin leave single-action identity uncertain.

start_date.summary: Both opened reports are dated 10 February 2024 and describe the action as occurring that day.

location.summary: S012 places the action before the Directorate of Agriculture in Devoll; S013 specifies Bilisht. Exact address and whether both reports describe precisely the same gathering remain unverified.

organizer.summary: The reports identify farmers, with S012 also naming livestock breeders; neither names a formal organizer.

demands.summary: S012 reports six agricultural requests, including milk reimbursement, and says collectors compared 120 Lek/liter with 170 they considered warranted. S013 instead says protesters opposed cheap imports and reports a 30% price decline attributed to imports, with nationwide protests threatened if government requests were not met; it does not specify those requests. Whether these are distinct facets of one protest or separate events remains unresolved.

participants_original.summary: Neither opened article gives an attendance figure. S012 mentions tractors but no number of people.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither body gives an attendance count or other evidence establishing >=50 people; threshold remains unknown.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; neither opened report discusses protester violence.

state_response.summary: All seven response variables remain unknown; neither body describes police or other state response.

episode_boundary.summary: The reports share date and general location but differ in stated focus (milk collection price and broad agriculture demands in S012; cheap imports in S013; milk processors in S006 search snippet). Whether these sources describe the same action, related actions, or a broader campaign and where the episode ends remain unresolved.

notes: Two opened February 10 reports (Balkanweb S012 and Albania Daily News S013) place farmers before the agriculture directorate in Devoll/Bilisht; Balkanweb also reports livestock breeders and tractors. S012 gives six agriculture demands and a 120-versus-170 Lek/liter milk-price claim. S013 reports opposition to cheap imports, a claimed 30% decline in local prices, and a conditional threat of nationwide protests. Same-action relation and origin remain uncertain. Neither body reports turnout, violence, state response or end date; the >=50 threshold remains unknown.
open_questions: Determine whether S006, S012 and S013 concern the same gathering or distinct actions; compare contemporaneous timing and reporting origins.
Establish attendance and >=50 threshold; none of the opened bodies gives a count.
Clarify the precise demands and organizer from additional evidence; retain differing frames rather than conflating them.
Obtain separate evidence on protester violence and each state-response field; currently unknown.
Determine campaign relationship and episode start/end.

title: Opposition rally in Tirana against alleged government corruption and refusal to investigate
location: Tirana, government headquarters / Prime Minister’s office
organizer: Opposition supporters; Euronews does not identify the rally organizers or resolve which Democratic Party faction organized it.
participants_original: Euronews reports thousands of opposition supporters; no exact count or independent estimate is given.
threshold_50_evidence: Euronews body says thousands of opposition supporters took part, which supports the >=50 threshold, though the count is qualitative and not independently corroborated here.

title.summary: Euronews body describes a 20 February rally against alleged government corruption and the cabinet’s refusal to create parliamentary commissions to investigate allegations; it also describes solidarity with Sali Berisha. The action’s mixed policy and partisan-support elements require codebook review.

start_date.summary: The Euronews article published 21 February dates the rally to Tuesday, 20 February 2024.

location.summary: Euronews places the gathering in front of Albania’s government headquarters in Tirana.

organizer.summary: Euronews identifies opposition supporters but does not establish a specific organizing body or faction.

demands.summary: The article identifies opposition protest against alleged corruption and cabinet refusal to form parliamentary commissions to investigate allegations involving the prime minister and other officials. It also describes solidarity with Sali Berisha. It does not report a demand that a politician resign; response/target coding and mixed partisan purpose require review.

participants_original.summary: Euronews describes thousands of opposition supporters without an exact number.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Euronews’s qualitative “thousands” supports at least 50 participants but is not independently corroborated here.

protester_violence.summary: Euronews reports that demonstrators threw stones and flares at police and pulled down an iron fence around the government building.

state_response.summary: The article mentions demonstrators throwing projectiles at police and says the protest ended peacefully, but does not specify arrests, beatings, crowd dispersal, killings, shootings, accommodation or deliberate ignoring. All seven response variables remain unknown.

episode_boundary.summary: The opened article describes the 20 February central Tirana demonstration. Whether it belongs to a longer organized opposition campaign or is part of multiple distinct episodes remains unresolved.

notes: A single opened Euronews report supports thousands of participants and a demonstration on 20 February before government headquarters. Reported demands concern alleged corruption and refusal to form parliamentary investigation commissions; the article also reports solidarity with Sali Berisha. It does not report a resignation demand. Euronews reports stones and flares thrown at police and a fence pulled down. This source gives no exact count, organizer hierarchy, or detailed state response. Campaign boundary and how to code mixed policy and partisan-support motives remain for review.
open_questions: Check other contemporary sources for corroboration and whether their attendance counts derive from the same origin.
Review whether the described policy demand plus solidarity for Berisha qualifies under the codebook’s mixed-objective rules.
Clarify specific organizers and Democratic Party faction involvement.
Do not code state response beyond reported facts; all seven response variables need separate evidence.
Determine campaign relationship, end date and episode boundary.
